name: IMG_PIXEL
summary: Sample an ISF image input at pixel coordinates.

name: IMG_NORM_PIXEL
summary: Sample an ISF image input at normalized (0–1) coordinates.

name: IMG_SIZE
summary: Returns the size (width, height) in pixels of an ISF image input.

name: IMG_THIS_PIXEL
summary: Sample an ISF image input at the current fragment's pixel coordinate.

name: IMG_THIS_NORM_PIXEL
summary: Sample an ISF image input at the current fragment's normalized coordinate.

name: RENDERSIZE
summary: Output render size in pixels (width, height).

name: isf_FragNormCoord
summary: Normalized (0–1) coordinate of the current fragment.

name: TIME
summary: Elapsed time in seconds since the composition started.

name: TIMEDELTA
summary: Time in seconds since the last rendered frame.

name: FRAMEINDEX
summary: Zero-based index of the current frame.

name: PASSINDEX
summary: Zero-based index of the current render pass.

name: DATE
summary: Current date and time: (year, month, day, seconds since midnight).

name: gl_FragCoord
summary: Window-space coordinate of the current fragment (x, y, z, 1/w).

name: texture
summary: Sample a texture at UV coordinates (GLSL ES 3.0). In ISF prefer IMG_PIXEL/IMG_NORM_PIXEL.

name: smoothstep
signature: genType smoothstep(genType edge0, genType edge1, genType x)
summary: Smooth Hermite interpolation returning 0 below edge0 and 1 above edge1.

name: mix
signature: genType mix(genType x, genType y, genType a)
summary: Linear interpolation: x*(1-a) + y*a.

name: clamp
signature: genType clamp(genType x, genType minVal, genType maxVal)
summary: Constrain x to lie between minVal and maxVal.

name: fract
summary: Returns the fractional part of x (x - floor(x)).

name: mod
summary: Modulo: x minus y*floor(x/y).

name: step
summary: Returns 0.0 if x < edge, else 1.0.

name: length
summary: Returns the Euclidean length of a vector.

name: normalize
summary: Returns a vector with the same direction as x but unit length.

name: dot
summary: Returns the dot product of x and y.

name: cross
summary: Returns the cross product of x and y.

name: pow
summary: Returns x raised to the power y.

name: atan
summary: Arc-tangent; two-argument form returns angle of vector (x, y).

name: sin
summary: Returns the sine of angle (in radians).

name: cos
summary: Returns the cosine of angle (in radians).

name: tan
summary: Returns the tangent of angle (in radians).

name: floor
summary: Returns the largest integer <= x.

name: ceil
summary: Returns the smallest integer >= x.

name: abs
summary: Returns the absolute value of x.

name: sign
summary: Returns -1.0, 0.0, or 1.0 based on the sign of x.

name: min
summary: Returns the lesser of x and y.

name: max
summary: Returns the greater of x and y.

name: reflect
summary: Returns the reflection of incident vector I around normal N.

name: refract
signature: genType refract(genType I, genType N, float eta)
summary: Returns the refraction vector of I through surface with normal N and index ratio eta.

name: distance
summary: Returns the Euclidean distance between two points.

name: radians
summary: Converts degrees to radians.

name: degrees
summary: Converts radians to degrees.

name: sqrt
summary: Returns the square root of x.

name: inversesqrt
summary: Returns 1.0 / sqrt(x).
